rule_title: TTP T1562.001 - Defender Feature Disabled via Set-MpPreference (PowerShell Command Line)
description: Detects Set-MpPreference being used to disable specific Defender protection features via the PowerShell command line (visible in EID 4688 CommandLine field). This covers feature-level disablement without requiring ScriptBlock logging — the full Set-MpPreference command with its parameter is captured in the process creation event. The parameters seen in this sample (-EnableControlledFolderAccess Disabled, -PUAProtection disable) are two of several critical features attackers commonly turn off. The broader parameter list covers the full range of Set-MpPreference disablement options.
